test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How much forestland, according to the passage, is destroyed every year?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that "every year, we destroy ten million hectares of forestlands."
 
• This deforestation significantly contributes to the decline in wildlife populations and results in habitat loss.

Thus, according to the passage, **Option 1: "Ten million hectares"** is the correct amount of forestland destroyed every year.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Two and half billion hectares"** – This figure is not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Option 3: "Twenty-seven trillion hectares"** – This figure is not mentioned in the passage and is implausible for annual forest destruction.
 
• **Option 4: "Two-and-a-half percent of land"** – This percentage is mentioned in relation to the extinction of certain animal species, not forestland destruction.
